frame: Level 1 scan frame of the Oct 18 capture, Y-up metres (upper-floor video placed via the upper-walk candidate and, for raw INSV frames, a per-submodel fit to the Cupix video-B stations by frame number); the Oct 18 provisional registration then maps every station to BIM (positionBIM).
navigation: Upper-video edges restricted to this floor: consecutive placed frames <= 7.7 m and rise <= 1.5 m = route; across a slab = stairs; non-consecutive same-floor links only when no BIM wall lies between stations <= 4 m apart (link-bim-clear, inferred from design walls). No links to other floors or to Level 1.

floorAssignment.rule: Level from the highest near-horizontal BIM surface under the station (L2/L3 within 0.45 m of the slab, else stairs). Stair stations go with the floor at the top of their flight: lowest slab above that BIM floor. Slabs (viewer frame, m): {"L1": 5.2, "L2": 9.4, "L3": 14.3}.

coverage: partial: one upper-floor video (VID_20261018_153400). Level 3: only the walked corridors; see walkGroups for disconnected parts.
placement: Frames from the raw 360-degree video VID_20261018_153400_00_477 (not a Cupix export). Positions: local structure-from-motion submodels fitted by frame number to the Cupix-placed stations of the same video (upper-walk candidate: photo matching to Level 1 + yaw/XYZ ICP to BIM), moved into the Level 1 scan frame; the provisional Oct 18 registration then maps them to BIM. A Cupix-free placement dry run (scripts/raw360_bim.py) differs by a median 0.09 m (max 0.31 m) over 79 frames. Provisional, not surveyed.
privacy: automatic blur (strict) + manual blur boxes after manual review of every image; publishing approved by the owner on 2026-10-28; not a claim of full anonymisation. Strict automatic blur = person score 0.15, crop 1536, fixed nadir cone. sha256 = published file.

source.metricsNote: Internal consistency only (fit to Cupix-placed stations; ICP residuals are distances to BIM design surfaces). Not surveyed accuracy.
